headline: Head of State Financial Monitoring Service Pronin Did Not Respond to 85 NSSMC Messages on Suspicious Transactions Worth UAH 222 Billion
summary: Ukraine's state financial monitoring service head Pronin did not respond to 85 messages from the NSSMC on suspicious transactions worth UAH 222 billion. The messages cover 2024 to August 17, 2026.
why: Financial monitoring bodies enforce anti-money-laundering rules, and their effectiveness affects banks' compliance obligations and the credibility of the financial system.
